The three typefaces in this directory are redistributed under the SIL Open
Font License, Version 1.1. Each is served from this server rather than from
Google Fonts because the cabinet's Content-Security-Policy is
`default-src 'self'` and the product is often installed on a network with no
route to the public internet.

The files are the Latin and Latin-Extended subsets of the variable fonts, as
served by Google Fonts.

  Inter
    Copyright (c) 2016 The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter)
    inter-latin.woff2, inter-latin-ext.woff2

  Space Grotesk
    Copyright (c) 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors
    (https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk)
    grotesk-latin.woff2, grotesk-latin-ext.woff2

  JetBrains Mono
    Copyright (c) 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
    (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
    mono-latin.woff2, mono-latin-ext.woff2

The full licence text is at https://scripts.sil.org/OFL. In short: the fonts
may be used, studied, modified and redistributed freely, including bundled
with software, as long as they are not sold on their own and this notice
travels with them.

To refresh a subset, ask Google Fonts for the CSS with a modern browser's
User-Agent and download the woff2 URLs it names for the `latin` and
`latin-ext` unicode ranges:

  curl -A "Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" \
    "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400..600&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500..700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400..600&display=swap"

The `unicode-range` declarations in `app.css` must keep matching the ranges
that CSS names, or a glyph outside the subset falls back to a system face.
